entries.packages/runtime/src/*.js: include_str! of packages/runtime/src/web.rs embeds each source into the runtime, which V8 evaluates; no import reaches it, and make test runs it through the Rust tests of packages/runtime

binaries.make: tests/tools/workflows.test.mts runs make ci-nextest of the Makefile to read the build jobs that it passes to Cargo; make is a system tool that no npm package provides

ignore.packages/build/tests/fixtures/**: input data of the build tests, some deliberately invalid; the Rust tests compile them
